#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string st;
    cin >> st;
    vector<char> c(st.begin(), st.end());
    int a1 = 0, a2 = 0;
    string sb, sb2;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (c[i] == '(') {
            sb.push_back('_');
            i++;
            while (i < n && c[i] != ')') {
                sb2.push_back(c[i]);
                i++;
            }
            sb2.push_back('_');
        } else if (i < n) {
            sb.push_back(c[i]);
        }
    }
    vector<string> parts;
    {
        stringstream ss(sb);
        string temp;
        while (getline(ss, temp, '_')) {
            parts.push_back(temp);
        }
    }
    for (const auto &part : parts) {
        a1 = max(a1, (int)part.length());
    }
    vector<string> inner_parts;
    {
        stringstream ss(sb2);
        string temp;
        while (getline(ss, temp, '_')) {
            inner_parts.push_back(temp);
        }
    }
    for (const auto &segment : inner_parts) {
        if (!segment.empty()) a2++;
    }
    cout << a1 << " " << a2 << "\n";
    return 0;
}
